# IMPERIA COLD WAR — Sami: Sweden 1970 and Nordic cooperation.
# IMPERIA COLD WAR — MD standard (B7): cost tooltips without GDP percentages (amounts shown by modify_treasury_effect)
# IMPERIA COLD WAR — Nordic Council programmes. Generated by tools/nordic_1970/build.py.

COLDWAR_NORDIC_country = {
	OR = { AND = { tag = SWE original_tag = SWE } AND = { tag = NRY original_tag = NRY } AND = { tag = DEN original_tag = DEN } AND = { tag = FIN original_tag = FIN } AND = { tag = ICE original_tag = ICE } }
}

COLDWAR_NORDIC_campaign = {
	COLDWAR_NORDIC_country = yes
	IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
}

COLDWAR_NORDIC_member = {
	COLDWAR_NORDIC_campaign = yes
	has_idea = COLDWAR_NORDIC_council_member
	exists = yes
}

}

COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_frozen = {
	COLDWAR_NORDIC_member = yes
	has_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_locked
	OR = { AND = { tag = SWE has_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_seat_SWE } AND = { tag = NRY has_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_seat_NRY } AND = { tag = DEN has_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_seat_DEN } AND = { tag = FIN has_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_seat_FIN } AND = { tag = ICE has_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_seat_ICE } }
}

COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_participant = {
	OR = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_frozen = yes AND = { NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_locked } COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_candidate = yes } }
}

COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_ready = {
	COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_participant = yes
	OR = { AND = { NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_locked } count_triggers = { amount = 2 SWE = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_candidate = yes } NRY = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_candidate = yes } DEN = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_candidate = yes } FIN = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_candidate = yes } ICE = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_candidate = yes } } } AND = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_locked AND = { OR = { NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_seat_SWE } SWE = { AND = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_frozen = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_suspended } } } } OR = { NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_seat_NRY } NRY = { AND = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_frozen = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_suspended } } } } OR = { NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_seat_DEN } DEN = { AND = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_frozen = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_suspended } } } } OR = { NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_seat_FIN } FIN = { AND = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_frozen = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_suspended } } } } OR = { NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_seat_ICE } ICE = { AND = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_frozen = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_suspended } } } } } } }
}

COLDWAR_NORDIC_investment_bank_can_pay = {
	AND = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_finance_frozen = yes OR = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_NORDIC_industrial_finance } NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_investment_bank_paid } COLDWAR_NORDIC_finance_vote_1_agreed = yes }
	COLDWAR_NORDIC_finance_ready = yes
	date > 1975.12.31
	check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_quote = { value = gdp_total multiply = 0.005 } }
	custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = COLDWAR_B7_nordic_cash_tt check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_NORDIC_quote compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
}

	custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = COLDWAR_B7_nordic_funded_tt AND = { OR = { NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_finance_seat_SWE } SWE = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_investment_bank_paid } } OR = { NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_finance_seat_NRY } NRY = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_investment_bank_paid } } OR = { NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_finance_seat_DEN } DEN = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_investment_bank_paid } } OR = { NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_finance_seat_FIN } FIN = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_investment_bank_paid } } OR = { NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_finance_seat_ICE } ICE = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_investment_bank_paid } } } }

COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_frozen = {
	COLDWAR_NORDIC_member = yes
	has_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_locked
	OR = { AND = { tag = SWE has_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_seat_SWE } AND = { tag = NRY has_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_seat_NRY } AND = { tag = DEN has_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_seat_DEN } AND = { tag = FIN has_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_seat_FIN } AND = { tag = ICE has_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_seat_ICE } }
}

COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_participant = {
	OR = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_frozen = yes AND = { NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_locked } COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_candidate = yes } }
}

COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_ready = {
	COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_participant = yes
	OR = { AND = { NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_locked } count_triggers = { amount = 2 SWE = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_candidate = yes } NRY = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_candidate = yes } DEN = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_candidate = yes } FIN = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_candidate = yes } ICE = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_candidate = yes } } } AND = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_locked AND = { OR = { NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_seat_SWE } SWE = { AND = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_frozen = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_suspended } } } } OR = { NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_seat_NRY } NRY = { AND = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_frozen = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_suspended } } } } OR = { NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_seat_DEN } DEN = { AND = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_frozen = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_suspended } } } } OR = { NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_seat_FIN } FIN = { AND = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_frozen = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_suspended } } } } OR = { NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_seat_ICE } ICE = { AND = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_frozen = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_suspended } } } } } } }
}

COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_busy = {
	OR = {
		SWE = {
			OR = {
				AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_office_leading has_shine_effect_on_focus = COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_office }
				AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_portable_rights_leading has_shine_effect_on_focus = COLDWAR_NORDIC_portable_rights }
				AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_regional_skills_leading has_shine_effect_on_focus = COLDWAR_NORDIC_regional_skills }
				AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_recognise_qualifications_leading has_shine_effect_on_focus = COLDWAR_NORDIC_recognise_qualifications }
				AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_settlement_leading has_shine_effect_on_focus = COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_settlement }
				AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_language_access_leading has_shine_effect_on_focus = COLDWAR_NORDIC_language_access }
				AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_working_life_leading has_shine_effect_on_focus = COLDWAR_NORDIC_working_life }
			}
		}
		NRY = {
			OR = {
				AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_office_leading has_shine_effect_on_focus = COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_office }
				AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_portable_rights_leading has_shine_effect_on_focus = COLDWAR_NORDIC_portable_rights }
